theorem lg_target (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n with d hd
  case zero => exact le_refl 0
  case succ d =>
    have : d ≤ f d := hd
    calc
      d + 1 ≤ f d + 1 ≤ f (d + 1)
      _ := add_le_add_left (le_refl 1) (StrictMono.add_le_nat hf d)
      _ := le_refl _
